Taj West End — hotel brand advertising (Bengaluru).

Brand advertising for the heritage Taj West End: "Tropical Escapes in the Heart of the City" sold through lantern-lit interiors; "Morning Meetings, Powered by Nature" on breakfast under the Rain Tree; and a grid of the property at its most indulgent. One gold-and-image system — history, nature, indulgence.

Brand campaign design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·55.
